source.quote: During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the Company repurchased 199,000 shares of its Class A common stock under the Stock Repurchase Program at a weighted-average price of $100.43 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $19,986.
We declared a quarterly dividend of $0.54 per share of Class A common stock to record holders in each quarter of fiscal 2026.
